description: Show the price of one SKU as of a date, in one currency and tier: the row picked is the latest valid_from at or before that date, and the answer names the row and any later one already booked. Free.

currency.description: Defaults to the shared business profile's currency

date.description: The day the price is wanted for, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

sku.description: The SKU code, e.g. WEB-AUDIT, or the product name when only one product carries it

name: sku_get
title: The price of one SKU on a date
